# TildaZ v0.8.2

**The drop-down is usable on sway, and idle output no longer waits for the next frame.**

- On sway, the drop-down now has keyboard focus the moment it opens, so you can type
  right after pressing the hotkey. Every other compositor already did this; sway left
  it to the window itself, which is where TildaZ now asks for it.
  ([#454](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/454))
- Output that arrives while the terminal sits idle reaches the screen right away
  instead of waiting for the next frame: Linux 8.8 → 0.6 ms, macOS 5.8 → 0.9 ms,
  Windows 8.3 → 1.5 ms. ([#439](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/439))
- On Windows, `Ctrl+Shift+P` opens the config in Notepad when no application is
  associated with `.json` — it used to do nothing at all.
  ([#456](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/456))
- Shutting TildaZ down with `SIGTERM` (a `kill`, or logging out) now closes the
  program it launched instead of leaving it behind, and opening the config or the log
  no longer leaves a zombie process on Linux.
  ([#458](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/458),
  [#457](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/457))

## Upgrade notes

- Building from source now requires Zig 0.16.0.
  ([#451](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/451))
- Windows: keep `_internal\` next to `tildaz.exe`, and the macOS artifact is still
  self-signed rather than Apple-notarized — both unchanged from v0.8.1. Upgrading
  from v0.8.1 needs no permission changes on macOS.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux portable (glibc 2.28+) | `tildaz-v0.8.2-linux-{x86_64,aarch64}.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./install.sh`; no `sudo`. |
| Linux Debian / Ubuntu | `tildaz_0.8.2-1_{amd64,arm64}.deb` | Install with `dpkg` or a graphical software installer. |
| Linux Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE | `tildaz-0.8.2-1.{x86_64,aarch64}.rpm` | Install with `dnf` or the distro package tool. |
| Linux distro-independent | `TildaZ-0.8.2-{x86_64,aarch64}.AppImage` | Make executable and run; FUSE is optional. |
| Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS | `tildaz-0.8.2-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` | x86_64 package. |
| macOS 14+ universal | `tildaz-v0.8.2-macos.dmg` | Apple Silicon and Intel; stable self-signed identity, not notarized. |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `tildaz-v0.8.2-win-x64.zip` | Unzip and keep `_internal\` next to `tildaz.exe`. |
| Windows 11 ARM64 | `tildaz-v0.8.2-win-arm64.zip` | ARM64-native binary; same layout as the x64 zip. |
